input.command: $h = Get-ChildItem 'D:\Animation-Model-Training\holdout-sources' -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; "holdout-sources: $([math]::Round($h.Sum/1MB,2)) MB, $($h.Count) 文件"; $c = Get-ChildItem 'D:\Animation-Model-Training\configs' -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; "configs: $([math]::Round($c.Sum/1MB,2)) MB, $($c.Count) 文件"

$dst = 'D:\backups\animtrain\2026-10-17-training-data'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dst | Out-Null; $src = 'D:\Animation-Model-Training'; foreach ($d in @('data','holdout-sources','configs')) { robocopy "$src\$d" "$dst\$d" /E /COPY:DAT /R:1 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NJH /NP | Out-Null; "copied $d : $((Get-ChildItem "$dst\$d" -Recurse -File | Measure-Object).Count) 文件, $([math]::Round((Get-ChildItem "$dst\$d" -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum/1MB,2)) MB" }
